ex.en: I may have left my umbrella in the bus.
ex.zh: 我可能把傘忘在公車上了。

ex.en: Don't forget to take your umbrella when you leave.
If you need an umbrella, I'll lend you one.
ex.zh: 如果你需要傘，我借你一把。

umbrella.en: a folding frame with cloth on top that you hold over your head to keep off rain

ex.en: The company operates under an umbrella brand.
ex.zh: 這家公司以一個總品牌經營。

ex.en: "Wellness" is an umbrella term for many health activities.
ex.zh: 「健康養生」是涵蓋許多保健活動的總稱。

umbrella.en: covering or including many different things

ex.en: Um, I'm not sure what to say.
Well, um, I think we should wait a little longer.
ex.zh: 呃，嗯，我覺得我們應該再等一下。

ex.en: The umpire called the runner out at second base.
ex.zh: 裁判判定跑者在二壘出局。

ex.en: Both sides agreed to ask an umpire to settle the dispute.
ex.zh: 雙方同意請一位仲裁人來解決爭議。

ex.en: My uncle umpires baseball games on weekends.
ex.zh: 我叔叔週末會擔任棒球比賽的裁判。

ex.en: She was asked to umpire the final match.
ex.zh: 她被請去擔任決賽的裁判。

ex.en: The doctor cut the baby's umbilical cord.
ex.zh: 醫師剪斷了嬰兒的臍帶。

ex.en: The nurse checked the umbilical area for signs of infection.
ex.zh: 護理師檢查肚臍周圍有沒有感染的跡象。

ex.en: The artist mixed umber into the paint to make it darker.
ex.zh: 畫家把棕土色顏料混進去讓顏色變深。

ex.en: The autumn leaves turned a warm umber.
ex.zh: 秋天的樹葉變成了溫暖的赭褐色。
